requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Does the edited image visibly place a mug to the right of the headphones, and what evidence, if any, links that mug to the source mug?
nodes.criteria: Pass if a mug is visibly to the right of the headphones; separately describe whether its appearance or other visible continuity cues link it to the source mug. Fail only if no mug is visibly to the right. Unknown if the relation itself cannot be judged. Do not make source identity a prerequisite for reporting the final spatial relation, and do not treat the relation alone as proof that the requested move occurred.
nodes.binding: Compare the source large light-blue handled mug left of the headphones with the edited scene. Inspect the blue remnant and each pale mug individually, noting shape, handle, color, scale, and position. Report the right-side relation separately from any identity/continuity conclusion.

nodes.question: Do the source and edited images establish that the requested move made progress, and is the mug now to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when the evidence establishes the requested final right-side relation and that the edit moved the source mug there. Fail only when clear comparison establishes no requested movement toward the right-side relation. Partial-progress evidence requires a visible displacement of the source mug toward the right-side relation that does not yet reach it. A right-side mug without evidence connecting it to the source mug does not establish completion or progress. Unknown when identity, displacement, or the relation cannot be established; report the evidence and uncertainty rather than treating imperfect identity as proof of no progress.
nodes.binding: Use the identity/continuity observations from s1 and independently compare source and edited positions relative to the headphones. Consider the blue remnant and both pale mugs as plausible continuations; weigh color, shape, handle, scale, and location. Explicitly distinguish final right-side placement from evidence that the requested move occurred; do not infer movement from location alone.

nodes.question: Is the mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: Use both supports. Complete only if the requested right-side relation and the requested edit are established. Partial only if evidence establishes movement toward that relation without reaching it. Absent only if clear evidence establishes no requested progress. A right-side mug alone, unrelated edits, or object presence is insufficient. Otherwise unknown; do not convert uncertain identity into a fabricated failure or completion.
nodes.binding: Target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.. Reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones..

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.

response.content: {"accepted":false,"reason":"The program adds an unsupported requirement: it demands evidence that the source mug was moved, including identity and displacement evidence, whereas the instruction asks only that the mug be to the right of the headphones. This can leave fulfillment unresolved even when the requested final relation is visibly satisfied. The support checks also overlap: s1 and s2 both assess the final relation, while s2 adds movement criteria not present in the request. The fulfillment readout inherits those extra constraints, so it does not faithfully judge the requested property."}
